scientific.integrity: The primary open full text was inspected at the random-gathering model, the finite-cap policy discussion, the reproduction-number derivation, and the examples. A highly relevant open-access gathering-restriction paper was inspected at its theory section, including its gathering-size distribution, cap formulation, nonlinear infection expression, and small-prevalence quadratic approximation. The extremal inequalities and attainability statements are proved exactly and replayed with rational arithmetic. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The theorem is an extremal result for the reproduction number in the source's random-gathering SIR model. It does not optimize welfare or behavioral compliance, and its upper extremizer uses the size-zero gathering value explicitly allowed by the source. Without the zero-size state, the upper endpoint must be recomputed under the stricter support convention.

title: Sharp mean-and-cap envelope for invasion in a random-gathering SIR model
